references.text: The Lord promises to be Israel's healer and keep them free from the diseases of Egypt if they obey His commands.
The Lord promises to bless food and water and remove sickness from the people.
Warns of boils and other diseases from Egypt as punishment for disobedience, in contrast to the promise of protection in 7:15.
Threatens that all the diseases of Egypt will strike Israel if they do not obey the Lord.
Continues the warning about diseases that will afflict the people due to disobedience.
Praises the Lord as the healer of all sickness, reflecting the promise of healing.
The Lord sends plagues upon the Egyptians while protecting Israel—demonstrating God's power over disease.
The Lord promises to place curses on Israel's enemies so that the enemies receive the plagues instead.
